title: Efficient reduction of stellar contamination and noise in planetary transmission spectra using neural networks
abstract: arXiv:2602.10330v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The characterization of exoplanetary atmospheres has been transformed by the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST), whose infrared sensitivity enables transmission spectroscopy at unprecedented precision. However, stellar heterogeneities (e.g., spots and faculae) remain a dominant source of contamination that can bias atmospheric retrievals if not properly corrected. We present a methodology for reducing stellar contamination and instrument-specific noise from exoplanet transmission spectra using neural networks, in particular the so-called Denoising AutoEncoders (DAEs). Our goals are to enable fast, accurate corrections that improve the reliability of atmospheric parameter retrievals and to promote the use of unsupervised algorithms for efficient data processing. translated_title: 利用神经网络高效减少行星透射光谱中的恒星污染和噪声
translated_abstract: 系外行星大气的研究已被詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜（JWST）所变革，其红外灵敏度使透射光谱学达到了前所未有的精度。然而，恒星不均匀性（如黑子和光斑）仍然是主要的污染源，如果不加以适当校正，可能会使大气参数反演产生偏差。我们提出了一种利用神经网络（特别是去噪自编码器，DAE）来减少系外行星透射光谱中恒星污染和仪器特定噪声的方法。我们的目标是实现快速、准确的校正，以提高大气参数反演的可靠性，并推广无监督算法在高效数据处理中的应用。我们使用类地行星（TRAPPIST-1e类似物）和亚海王星行星（K2-18b类似物）的大型合成数据集设计并训练了DAE架构。大气反演……
tldr: 该论文提出使用去噪自编码器（DAE）神经网络来快速准确地去除系外行星透射光谱中的恒星污染和仪器噪声，从而提高大气参数反演的可靠性。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a neural network approach using Denoising AutoEncoders (DAEs) to efficiently remove stellar contamination and instrument noise from exoplanet transmission spectra, enabling fast and accurate corrections that improve the reliability of atmospheric parameter retrievals.
